items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: No he was a friend of mine.

ctx.x: All I could remember now, for sure, I know Jim was there, Big Jim, Robinson, and Edgar Mosley, the drum. That's but all I could remember. It's been such a long time ago. Well who paid you for that? Well we had the speakeasy at that time. You know what I mean by speakeasy. Well they had speakeasy, and the guy that operated the speakeasy, he paid for it. Because we left from his place, and we came back to his place, and brought the crowd.
Well he might have made money on that deal. Well he did. Was he a friend of Buddy's or something? No he was a friend of mine. He put up the money, huh? Oh yeah.
I used to play a lot of dancing for him at Poisevere and Hall of Economy, Incorporated, and so forth. What was his name? Ernest Delaro. He died some time back in Chicago.
